card.title: One Step from Distance
card.instruction: Treat pauses, divided attention, and small boundaries as signs that the connection may be slipping away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said maybe to Friday dinner. Should I stop keeping your chair clear?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to check my shift. I've asked for Friday off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Off work, or off coming here every week?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Off work. Can we eat at seven? I need an early night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seven's fine. Shall I serve pudding with the main so you don't have to stay for another course?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reads a maybe as loss of the regular place, A3 suspects time away from visits, and A5 treats an early night as pressure to reduce staying.

relationship.evidence: B2 is trying to secure the visit and B4 offers a workable time with a reasonable rest boundary.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's early-night need to serve courses together, revealing fear that time together is unwelcome.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes weekly Friday dinner and B2 identifies a shift uncertainty.
